name: 63801 · Sikeston, MO
findings: ZIP 63801 (Sikeston) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63801 (Sikeston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63801 (Sikeston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
